notes.title: The Bus DLC Hamburg City – New version available
notes.notes:
The new version of the popular The Bus DLC Hamburg City is now available on Steam!


A huge thank you to our community—many of your suggestions and requests have been included in this update.

Of course, not everything can be implemented right away. Adjustments to bus mods are still limited, as there isn’t a usable vehicle editor yet.
New buses aren’t part of the Hamburg DLC itself, since in The Bus, vehicles and maps are separate content.
However, Steam bundles that combine both could be possible in the future.


What’s new in this version?
The most noticeable change is the many new Hamburg lamps and streetlights.
Over ten new variants have been added, from whip lights in different shapes to double masts with spotlights and new lighting on traffic islands.
This makes Hamburg’s streets even more atmospheric at night. Check out the comparison images of old vs. new lighting in this news post.

Announcements have also been expanded and refined, for example at terminal stops and transfer points.
Plus, new city details have been added, like the blue crane in front of the Museum of Work in Barmbek. Even if the bus doesn’t pass directly by, it adds to the authentic atmosphere.
Timetables and fleet files have been updated, and some objects now have improved collision detection.


Looking ahead
We’re already working on more features, including AI buses on lines 6 and 17, which are currently being tested in the base game.
The northern route extension with line 7 is also in progress, and we’ll share more details soon. The updated lighting will, of course, be included on this new section as well.


Changelog
New Hamburg lamps and streetlights

Added announcements for transfer points

English announcements added at the main station

Travel times from depot to starting stop adjusted

Fleet file updates

Improved collision detection for objects

New objects, e.g., historic crane at the Museum of Work in Barmbek

Corrections to terminal stop announcements


Steam Update
The update will be delivered automatically via Steam. Depending on your settings, it may download immediately or later.
If you don’t want to wait, you can start the download manually by clicking the button next to the entry in the Steam client.
New players will, of course, receive the latest version right away.


Stay connected
Follow us on Facebook or subscribe to our newsletter to stay up to date. Even faster, join our Telegram channel for instant push notifications straight to your smartphone.



Enjoy your time in virtual Hamburg!

notes.title: The Bus DLC Hamburg City – Update 1
notes.notes:
The Bus DLC – Hamburg City: New version now available on Steam

A new version of our popular Hamburg City DLC for The Bus is now available for download on Steam.
This update brings initial optimisations and adjustments to the Hamburg map.
Existing installations can easily be updated via Steam.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629408/f9795338c802f5db24281cbac00420833dbf44da.jpg"]

In addition to the ongoing improvement of the map and testing of new main game features such as AI buses, we are already working intensively on upcoming expansions.
More on this very soon.
One current focus is the different lamp types that have been individually modelled for Hamburg – these will be added to the game shortly.

Changelog of the current version:

Revised parking at Goldbekplatz

Added lighting to underground entrances at Steinstraße and Hauptbahnhof

Adjusted road traffic between Zimmerstraße and Averhoffstraße

Added footprints for AI pedestrians in certain areas

Various smaller optimisations

Additional bus stop positions for creating your own routes:

Hauptbahnhof/ZOB

Kurt-Schumacher-Allee (towards Hauptbahnhof)

Arrival stop Brandstwiete

Installation note
If the update does not start automatically:
Simply go to your Steam library, click on Downloads, and then press the download button next to The Bus.

Important note:
The Hamburg City DLC can only be displayed correctly with the retail version of The Bus.
You should by no means play the DLC with The Bus Beta 3.2, as this will inevitably cause errors.
